title: C2 Milestone 15
completion_message: ¡Gloria absoluta! Has superado el Milestone 15 y completado la última lección formal del nivel C2. Tienes un vocabulario y una gramática que solo el top 1% de los hablantes de inglés en el mundo posee. Eres un verdadero maestro del idioma de los negocios globales. ¡Felicidades!

parts.visual:
Este Milestone final evalúa tus habilidades como líder visionario: 

1. Public Speaking: 
- Captivate the audience & Cut to the chase. 
- Rhetorical question & Anecdote. 
- Rule of three & Key takeaways. 

2. Global Economics: 
- Sanctions, Embargo & Tariffs. 
- Protectionism & Subsidy. 
- Monopoly & Trade deficit. 
- GDP & Default.
parts.audio: Welcome to Milestone 15, Global Visionary. This is the final exam of the C2 level. First, we will test your Public Speaking skills. Do you know how to captivate an audience, cut to the chase, use anecdotes, rhetorical questions, and the rule of three? Second, Global Economics. You must prove your understanding of international sanctions, embargoes, tariffs, subsidies, protectionism, monopolies, and national defaults.

parts.visual:
3. Cleft Sentences (Énfasis): 
- IT WAS John WHO broke it. 
- WHAT I need IS coffee. 
- ALL I want IS peace. 
- THE REASON WHY I left WAS the stress. 

4. Future Tech & Innovation: 
- Bleeding-edge & Obsolescence. 
- Disruptor & Singularity. 
- Autonomous & Scalability. 
- State-of-the-art & Breakthrough. 

¡Demuestra que eres un maestro absoluto del inglés C2!
parts.audio: Third, Cleft Sentences for emphasis. Remember the structures: IT WAS John WHO broke it. WHAT I need IS coffee. ALL I want IS peace. And THE REASON WHY I left WAS the stress. Finally, Future Tech and Innovation. Vocabulary like bleeding-edge technology, planned obsolescence, industry disruptors, the technological singularity, autonomous systems, scalability, and major scientific breakthroughs. Show the world that you are an absolute master of C2 English. Good luck on the final exam!

stages.title: The Milestone Quiz
stages.description: El desafío final. Demuestra tu vocabulario macroeconómico, tecnológico y tu sintaxis avanzada.

questions.question: Normal: I hate the traffic in this city. -> Énfasis: ____ I hate is the traffic in this city.
When a company or technology completely changes an industry and destroys the old business models, it is a ____.
To force the country to stop its nuclear program, the United Nations imposed heavy economic ____.
The speaker started with a funny, personal ____ about his childhood to break the ice.
Normal: Mark broke the server. -> Énfasis en Mark: ____ Mark who broke the server.
The point in the future where AI surpasses human intelligence is called the technological ____.
To protect local farmers, the government gives them a $50 million ____ every year so they don't go bankrupt.
I don't have time for a long explanation. Please just ____ to the chase.
questions.explanation: Cut to the chase (ir al grano).

questions.question: Normal: I only want a chance to explain. -> Énfasis: ____ I want is a chance to explain.
If you buy 100 billion from China but only sell them 20 billion, your country has a massive trade ____.
This software is highly experimental and might crash. It uses ____-edge technology.
When he asked 'Do you want to be rich?', he didn't expect us to answer. It was a ____ question.
Normal: We got married in 2010. -> Énfasis en 2010: It was in 2010 ____ we got married.
Placing a 30% tariff on imported cars to help local factories is a policy known as economic ____.
I didn't have time to prepare my speech, so I'm just going to ____ it. (Improvisar).
If our app goes viral and a million people log in at once, the servers will crash. We lack ____.
Normal: I left because I was exhausted. -> Énfasis en la razón: The reason ____ I left was the exhaustion.
When the government completely prohibits all trade with another country, it is a trade ____.
To wrap up my presentation, let me summarize the three key ____ that I want you to remember.
Normal: The constant delays frustrate me. -> Énfasis: What frustrates me ____ the constant delays.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave (Economía, Tech, Oratoria o Gramática).

questions.question: ____ I need is sleep. (Lo que necesito con W)
____ I want is water. (Todo lo que quiero con A)
____ was Sarah who did it. (Cleft con I)
Heavy economic ____. (Sanciones con S)
A 20% ____ on steel. (Arancel con T)
Cut to the ____. (Ir al grano con C)
A funny ____. (Anécdota con A)
A massive industry ____. (Disruptor con D)
____-edge technology. (Súper experimental con B)
Infinite ____. (Escalabilidad con S)
